current_forecast.detailed_forecast: Mostly cloudy, with a low around 77. South wind around 5 mph.

seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of rain showers between 9am and 10am, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Partly sunny.
